PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Stores a player's Bubble Shooter Pro global profile, high score, stars, unlocked level, daily reward state, coins, and gameplay preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Player display name shown on profile and settings.

highScore.description: Highest single-level score achieved by the player.

totalStars.description: Cumulative stars earned across all 100 levels (0 to 300).

highestUnlockedLevel.description: Highest unlocked level number from 1 to 100.

bonusCoins.description: Bonus coins earned from daily rewards and level completions for rainbow boosters.

lastClaimedDailyRewardDay.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) when the player last claimed the daily gift box, or empty string if never claimed.

soundEnabled.description: Whether synthesized arcade sound effects are enabled.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether tactile vibration feedback on pops is enabled.

aimGuideExtended.description: Whether extended wall-bounce dotted aim guide is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LevelProgress.title: LevelProgress
LevelProgress.description: Stores a player's best score, earned stars, completion state, and attempts for a specific level (1 to 100).

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching parent userId.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved on this level.

stars.description: Highest stars earned on this level (0 to 3).

completed.description: Whether the player has cleared this level at least once.

attempts.description: Total number of times the player played this level.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when first recorded. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user Bubble Shooter Pro global profile, high score, unlocked level, daily rewards, and settings.

/users/{userId}/level_progress/{levelDoc.description: Per-user level progress documents keyed as level_1 through level_100.
